theories.claim: PreviewOffset increment on ActionDown lacks upper-bound clamp, allowing unbounded scroll offset beyond content length

theories.confirmation_condition: ActionDown branch for Preview != nil does m.PreviewOffset++ with no max check, and renderFrame AtOffset could exceed bodyLines length without graceful empty view
theories.refutation_condition: Viewport or renderPreview caps offset or preview tests show scrolled view still renders valid lines, or model clamps offset elsewhere
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot determine viewport clamping without executing renderFrame bounds or seeing prior diff for preview height logic
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read model.go key handling for preview offset and views.go renderFrame/viewport logic; grep for clamp/max checks
